title: Helping Small Businesses Become More Data-Driven: A Field Experiment on eBay
eligible_reason: Randomized staggered rollout of eBay Seller Hub access to 184,222 sellers in six in-window cohorts (May 12, May 19, Jun 6, Jun 13, Jun 21, Jul 26 2016) plus a seventh group (Aug 8) whose access date falls after the last panel week (Aug 6), so it is never treated in-window. Treatment SHaccess is an absorbing 0/1 indicator switching on at the seller's access date. Main ITT specifications are plain TWFE (seller FE + week FE, no controls, cluster by seller) on log outcomes; an unstacked relative-week event study is also reported. Appendix A5.5 re-estimates the sales ITT with Callaway-Sant'Anna, Sun-Abraham and Roth-Sant'Anna via the R 'staggered' package.
design_notes: Seller-week panel, 23 weeks (2016-03-05 to 2016-08-06), 184,222 sellers (full data) / 18,422 sellers (10% random sample shipped). SHaccess = 1*(WeekEndingDate >= TreatmentDate). Outcomes log(GMV+1), log(QtySold+1), log(Price) if Price>0, log(Feedback) if Feedback>0, log(numNewListings+1). FE: factor(ID) + factor(WeekEndingDate); SE clustered on ID; lfe::felm with exactDOF=T. Table 2: ITT, first stage (SHadoption on SHaccess), IV TOT, TOT on 1-week adopters. Table 3: same three columns per outcome. Table 4: SHaccess x Homog category interactions. Table 5: SHaccess x PerformanceVisits moderation. Event study: relative-week dummies binned at <=-8 and >=+8 with relative week 0 omitted. Appendix: A4 event studies for other outcomes, A5.3 group-specific trend tests, A5.4 ITT omitting one cohort at a time, A5.5 staggered-package CS/SA/Roth-SA simple ATT vs TWFE, A5.6 ITT by seller size segment, A5.7 Homog robustness. Treatment-date groups in 10% sample: 616 / 580 / 1,320 / 5,414 / 3,776 / 944 / 5,772 sellers (May12..Aug08).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Six cohorts treated within the panel window; the Aug 8 2016 group (5,772 of 18,422 sample sellers) receives access two days after the last panel week and acts as a never-treated-in-window control.

published_estimates.source: package log logPanelMainAnalysis_Lines1_105.txt (full data run); not verified against article

data_files_note: Shipped: panelCln_noCustID_Sample.csv (423,706 seller-weeks, 18,422 sellers = ~10% random sample) and SlrLvlCln_noCustID_Sample.csv (18,422 rows; ID, TreatmentDate, OptInDate, GMV2015); surveySample.csv and CatEPIDSample.csv for appendix analyses. Full files panelCln_noCustID.csv / SlrLvlCln_noCustID.csv (184,222 sellers) require approval from eBay legal (contact in Readme.pdf). Package also ships full-data R logs with all main-table output.
software_note: R: lfe::felm, data.table, stargazer; staggered package for appendix A5.5
screener_notes: Clean candidate: randomized staggered rollout, absorbing binary treatment, TWFE with unit+time FE and no controls, never-treated-in-window group present, six cohorts, and the authors themselves report CS/SA/Roth-SA comparisons (appendix A5.5). Exact replication needs the full eBay data (approval route documented in README); the shipped 10% random sample supports an approximate replication of every main spec and the code runs on it unchanged (switch the commented read.csv lines). Published coefficients above are taken from the full-data logs in the package, not from the article, and should be checked against the published tables when text is available. Appendix-only eligible specs not listed: A4 event studies (Quantity, Price, Feedback, NewListings), A5.4 leave-one-cohort-out ITTs, A5.6 segment ITTs/adopter regressions. Spec T2_c2 (first stage on the take-up indicator) is included because it meets the mechanical rules; drop if the lead wants outcome regressions only.
